profile.headline:
Software Engineer
AWS Certified Solutions Architect

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered new software programs with the ETL pipeline to ingest new data feeds for business
analytics.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Java webservices for the cloud.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Integrated an application with a web crawler to summarize websites.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
Worked closely with Server Administrators to provide support for Linux and Windows servers.
Repaired networking and lab equipment.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed a Python program that interacted with Twitter's API to create a relevant database of tweets for natural language analysis.

positions.title: IT System Administrator
positions.description:
Improved the efficiency and security of the office network by fine tuning the software and the router.
Created a Python program to balance mining mills, this reduced in half the time spent on the task.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Developed and released to the Windows 8 App Store the games "Game of Thrones Matching Game" and "Famous Movie Quotes".

positions.title: Team Member
positions.locationName: Manchester, NH and Saint Louis, MO
positions.description: My team won three awards and managed to qualify for the championship. I contributed in the design, assembly and construction of a robot that could play basketball.

honors.title: Rookie All Star Award, Coopertition Award, Highest Rookie Seed Award
honors.description:
The Rookie All-Star Award celebrates the rookie team exemplifying a young but strong partnership effort, as well as implementing the mission of FIRST to inspire students to learn more about science and technology. The Coopertition Award celebrates the team that best demonstrates the ability 
to help their opponents compete. The Highest Rookie Seed Award celebrates the highest scoring rookie team at the conclusion of the competition.
honors.issuer: Issued by First Robotics Competition · Mar 2012
